text:
maya: heads-up: customer observed what looks like a double token charge when a streaming toolcall aborted and we retried the fallback model.
jonathan: ugh. do we have traceid/sessionid in their logs? any quick repro steps?
sasha: yes repro steps in ticket 3871, pasted logs show session_id=abc-123 and two toolcall completions within 2s. cc @sri
sri: can you paste the relevant log snippet? I'm wondering if this is the handoff path or a resume path mismatch.
maya: log:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:01Z] session=abc-123 stream-start model=ollama-v1
[2026-03-15T10:12:05Z] toolcall=start id=tc-77
[2026-03-15T10:12:07Z] toolcall=error id=tc-77 code=EPIPE
[2026-03-15T10:12:08Z] fallback=route model=redwood-small toolcall=start id=tc-78
[2026-03-15T10:12:09Z] toolcall=complete id=tc-78 tokens=142
[2026-03-15T10:12:09Z] stream=complete session=abc-123 tokens=142
```
jonathan: so the original toolcall never returned a complete but we recorded tokens for the fallback only. where's the double-charge?
maya: customer says their billing line shows 284 tokens charged (142 twice). they use client-side reconnect and sometimes streams replay the prefix; could be duplicate accounting from both routes.
kevin: telemetry dump shows two ledger entries: one provisional from the first attempt and one confirmed from the fallback. provisional wasn't cleared on handoff.
sri: that's the key — provisional charges should be triangular: provisional assigned to route A, when route A errors and route B confirms we should move provisional->confirmed on route B and clear route A provisional. we currently leave provisional and add confirmed -> double bill.
sasha: is this specific to toolcalls? or streaming in general?
kevin: toolcalls create separate ledger items because they're accounted at call-complete; stream tokens are incremental. race when abort happens mid-chunk can create duplicate ledger items.
jonathan: proposal: on handoff, attach provenance header `X-Session-Origin` and `X-Provisional-Id` so ledger can dedupe provisional by session origin, then migrate.
maya: also console UX: in billing view show "provisional" vs "confirmed" and expiry TTL. current console conflates them.
sri: agree. for short-term mitigation we can expire provisional faster (30s) or auto-reconcile when a later confirmed shares same `X-Session-Origin` and token range overlap.
kevin: downside: if provisional expires too fast legitimate long-running streams lose protection. need conservative TTL + reconcile job.
sasha: telemetry: add `provisional_count` and `migrated_count` metrics and a tag `handoff=true` for joins. that'll help QA and rollout canary.
jonathan: API change: add `session_id` in streaming proto (SSE) and ensure router preserves it across fallback. PR incoming.
maya: ok can we do action items:
- jonathan: PR to add session_id header + router preservation (ETA EOD)
- kevin: reconcile job prototype + metrics (ETA 2d)
- sasha: console mock for provisional/confirmed UX (ETA 3d)
- sri: design doc for ledger migration semantics (ETA 2d)
- ops-bot: create canary rollout for router change in staging
ops-bot: created canary rollout job: job/route-preserve-session-staging v1 -> 5% traffic
jonathan: tagging @all for visibility, will link PR when ready :eyes: 
maya: thanks everyone. i'll add the ticket with reproducer and billing export.
